global.title: Space Force to start work on next GPS ground system after OCX failure
global.summary: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Space Force is starting work on a new ground control architecture for its future GPS constellation, applying lessons from the $6.27 billion OCX program that the Pentagon canceled earlier this year after 15 years of development.

global.title: Lawrence Livermore telescope used in Space Force ‘cat-and-mouse’ exercise
global.summary: WASHINGTON — A Rocket Lab spacecraft used an optical payload developed by Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory to track another satellite during a U.S. Space Force exercise testing how quickly spacecraft can be launched and put to work inspecting objects in orbit.
global.why: Kept so the editor has a record of what was reported, not because a full desk sweep was done.
